html:
Getting your car interior protected against accidental food and drink spills is a great way of keeping your interior looking newer for longer. In addition, the best vinyl protectors reduce the possibility of seats and carpets from absorbing these spills therefore helping keep odours at bay.

Our Range of Sirius Car Care Products

  • Fabric protection – exceptional protection for your car’s fabric surfaces. It works by creating a barrier that protects against food and spills that could otherwise stain or discolour fabric surfaces.
  • Vinyl and leather protection – the best vinyl protectant for cars that penetrate deep into vinyl surfaces and nourishes it. By working from deep within the vinyl, it helps reduce the damaging effects of UV rays and reduces cracking and drying.
  • Darkest legal tyres – moisturises and protects your tyres from cracking, fading and drying out. It also provides a deep gloss that can be adjusted to suit your individual taste by applying extra coats.

Learn More About the Best Interior Vinyl Protectant

Speak to your local Tint a Car store to learn more about Sirius – the best vinyl protectant in the market. We can walk you through the benefits of protecting your car’s surfaces and help you keep your car looking its best!
